messages:
marie_s: Kicking off Newton Health surge experiment — need to validate sustained 200 qps with p95 < 300ms and p99 < 800ms. Smoke tomorrow 09:00 PT. Who owns load harness + security checklist?

emily_sales: Confirmed with Newton. They will send corpus + SSO test creds by EOD. Asking for IP allowlist too.

sam_se: I can own the harness. Proposed phases: smoke (5m), ramp (30m) to 200 qps, soak (2h) at 200 qps. Will use Artillery + prefix caching.

sam_se: Test command (draft):
```
artillery run --target https://api.redwood.ai -m 200 -d 7200 -c 50 workload.yaml
```
Also will warm KV cache first: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/cache/warmup -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST'`

raj_eng: Re: model pinning — pin to `rwl-1.2-quant` for this run to avoid cold-start variability. Set `worker_pool=64` and `max_batch_tokens=4096` for repeatability.

nora_ops: I'll provision a reserved pool and set an autoscale lock during the window. ETA infra ready: tomorrow 08:30 PT. Will add IP allowlist for load generators.

ton_ycustomer: Newton SRE here — we require PII masking in logs, and no request bodies to leave our VPC for the soak. Also need TLS cert thumbprints and endpoint list.

cso_bot: Security checklist (automated): provide SSO test account, IP allowlist for load agents, SOC2 link: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2, and a short data-flow diagram. Please upload to the secure questionnaire form.

raj_eng: Metrics plan: push prometheus labels `customer=newton`, `test=surge-exp`. Record p50/p95/p99, tail-latency histograms, CPU/GPU utilization, and token throughput. Alert if p99 > 1s or error_rate > 1%.

sam_se: Quick pricing note: rough incremental burn for a 2h soak at 200 qps (rough token mix) is ~1800 token-minutes => estimate $1.2k. Ethan, can you confirm?

ethan_fin: Rough calc looks like ~$1.1k additional. If they migrate to a dedicated reserved pool that cost drops into commit. I'll prepare a short cost note for the proposal.

emily_sales: I'll coordinate creds and legal ask. Tony, can you provide the corpus and the allowlist IPs by EOD?

ton_ycustomer: We'll upload corpus + allowlist by 17:00 PT. Also looping in our security lead for the questionnaire.

marie_s: Action items: Sam = harness/run; Nora = infra + allowlist; Raj = model pin/config; Emily = creds/coord; Tony = corpus/IPs; Ethan = cost note. I'll run a 09:30 sync after smoke. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: reserved pool rp-7782 created by nora_ops at 2025-03-12T08:34:12Z

sam_se: Smoke done — 5m, no errors. p95=210ms, p99=490ms. Starting ramp.

sam_se: Ramp complete, held 200 qps steady for 30m. p95=230ms p99=520ms error_rate=0.05%.

sam_se: Soak 1h checkpoint: p95=240ms p99=560ms, GPU mem stable, no OOMs. CPU spiky but within limits.

ton_ycustomer: Good so far. Security lead flagged the data-flow doc — will review tonight.

emily_sales: Newton says if long soak looks stable, they'll want a 24h smoke next week before procurement sign-off.

marie_s: Great. Sam, please attach the run artifacts (artillery report + prometheus snapshots) to the deal folder. Ethan, attach the cost note. I'll update the opportunity with results and next steps.

sam_se: Uploaded artifacts to Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Nx... (private to team + newton). Short results:
- total_requests: 864k
- avg_tokens/sec: 750
- p95=240ms p99=560ms
- errors: 0.04% (rate-limit spikes during ramp only)

marie_s: Thanks everyone. We'll wait on security sign-off and then run the 24h smoke next week. cc legal@redwood
